about-text-1: I am a final year Master's student at FER, where I completed my undergraduate studies with magna cum laude honors. I come from Međimurje, and spent my early childhood in Slovenia where I was born.
about-text-2: I am diligent and resourceful, and consider myself a friendly and open person. I am constantly looking for new challenges and eagerly embrace opportunities.

exp-1-desc: I am part of the backend team actively contributing to the development of a parking system used in over fifty Croatian and regional cities. I have completed 2 major projects: modernization of the price calculation system for SMS payment channel and an integration project for two-way payment on parking meters consisting of multiple microservices.
exp-2-desc: I participated in an intensive five-week internship focused on embedded software. During the program, I built an LCD-based e-book reader in C using ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS. My final project was selected as the best.
exp-3-desc: Provided assistance to students and support to instructors in conducting lab exercises:
hobbies-text-1: Besides watching series and movies (especially sitcoms and fantasy), I often play pub quizzes (and have tried organizing them). I love to travel, and I also enjoy playing guitar.
hobbies-text-2: I tutor high school and elementary school students in STEM subjects.
